title: The Black Hole of Empire
note: Rudrangshu Mukherjee's scholarly monograph was published by Princeton University Press in 2010. Chapter 1 examines the documentary history of the confinement, Holwell's account and its reception, and the memorial's later imperial framing. Bibliographic details verified against the publisher's book page; this record uses the chapter 1 sample PDF.
subcategory: Black Hole historiography and imperial memory
whyItMatters: Mukherjee compares the surviving accounts and argues that Holwell's narrative should not be mistaken for independent corroboration. He also analyzes how the memorial and later retellings shifted responsibility and made the episode serve imperial memory; these are scholarly interpretations, not settled measurements of the event.
